theorems.name: Submission.deGiorgiSobInd_mollified_integral_tendsto
theorems.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Rn N)) (ζ : Rn N → ℝ) (ρ : ℕ → Rn N → ℝ) (r : ℕ → ℝ) (δ : ℝ), Continuous ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → μ (Metric.cthickening δ (tsupport ζ)) < ∞ → (∀ j, Continuous (ρ j)) → (∀ j y, 0 ≤ ρ j y) → (∀ j, ∫ y, ρ j y = 1) → (∀ j, tsupport (ρ j) ⊆ Metric.closedBall (0 : Rn N) (r j)) → (∀ j, r j ≤ δ) → Tendsto r atTop (𝓝 0) → Tendsto (fun j ↦ ∫ z, (∫ y, ζ y * ρ j (y - z)) ∂μ) atTop (𝓝 (∫ z, ζ z ∂μ))
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
